messages:
Meera Patel: Quick check — planning a coordinated Marketplace listing w/ NovaHW appliance + Orion SI. Target announce 2026-04-15. Need final on committed-spend tiers, whether partner discounts can stack with Marketplace private-offer discounts, and renewal cadence. Can we lock this by EOD Friday?

Dylan Chen: +1 on timeline. NovaHW wants a clear top-tier incentive. Do we have margins to go >20% total? :thinking_face:

Rajiv Singh: We can squeeze to ~22% for top-tier if the appliance upsell drives predictable usage. Need SI to commit to a 6mo onboarding retainer to get the extra 3%.

Ivy Thompson: Heads-up: legal/compliance. Marketplace rules sometimes block stacking coupon/promotional credits + private-offer discount. Need to check Marketplace policy and internal commerce rules. I can confirm by Thu AM.

Meera Patel: Here's a working draft for tiers (very rough):

```
Tier 1 - Onramp: $50k/yr commit -> 10% Redwood rebate + 3% NovaHW credit = 13% total
Tier 2 - Growth: $150k/yr commit -> 17% Redwood rebate + 5% NovaHW credit = 22% total
Tier 3 - Enterprise: $400k/yr commit -> 22% Redwood rebate + 8% NovaHW credit + SI retainer -> 30% total (conditional)
```

Meera Patel: Also thinking renewal window: 90-day renewal notice with a 30-day grace top-up to keep committed discount. If they drop below floor, we ramp to a sustained baseline price. Thoughts?

Dylan Chen: For joint announce messaging, NovaHW wants co-signed PR and marketplace featured tile. That requires us to confirm private-offer SKU and discount matrix by 04/01 so product/marketing have time.

Rajiv Singh: SI (Orion) requested that their onboarding retainer be mandatory for Tier 3 discount. Otherwise they won't guarantee migration SLAs. Fine by us but call it out in contract.

Ivy Thompson: Confirmed: Marketplace prohibits external coupon stacking with private-offer line-item discounts in most regions. However, partner rebates processed off-platform (via channel credits or invoice credits) can be allowed as long as they aren't presented as additional marketplace discount. That means we can *effectively* stack, but not show both on the marketplace UI. Legal will draft wording to avoid double-counting.

Meera Patel: Good note. So UX will show the private-offer price (Redwood discount applied). NovaHW/Orion will handle their credit post-sale. That keeps Marketplace rules clean.

Dylan Chen: Action items: I'll get NovaHW written confirmation on the post-sale credit approach and % by Wed. @Meera — can you confirm finance ok with the Tier 3 blended margin?

Meera Patel: @Dylan yes, I'll run numbers with Finance today. If Tier 3 is >28% blended discount we need CFO sign-off. Otherwise product ops can prepare SKU.

Ivy Thompson: I'll draft the contract clause (no stacking on UI; partner credit processed off-platform) and circulate by Thu. Also looping in Commerce to confirm global listing constraints.

MarketplaceBot: Private offer draft created: https://marketplace.example/offers/9876 (status: draft)

Rajiv Singh: Proposed rollout cadence: internal enablement week of 04/06, partner training week of 04/13, marketplace announce 04/15. We should run a canary private offer for 2 customers first.

Meera Patel: Agree on canary. Let's pick 2 pilot accounts with existing NovaHW appliance pilots. I'll propose list by EOD.

Dylan Chen: Noted. Also need to lock on renewal uplift: +5% price step if commit not renewed within 30 days of expiry. Can marketing call that an "early-renew" incentive?

Ivy Thompson: Legal ok with a structured uplift; just avoid language that looks like penalty. "Early-renew incentive" + clear pro-rated opt-out is safer.

Meera Patel: Summary & owners:
- Finalize discount stack approach (off-platform partner credits): Ivy (legal) by Thu
- NovaHW confirmation on % and process: Dylan by Wed
- Finance approval on Tier 3 blended margin: Meera by EOD today
- Draft private-offer SKU + canary list: Product Ops after finance ok (target 04/01)
- Marketplace listing draft: Marketing once SKU locked (target 04/06)

Dylan Chen: Sounds good. Ping me if you want me to join NovaHW call tomorrow.

Meera Patel: Thanks team — will follow up with final numbers. :thumbsup:
